audience: Rill is for someone who already pays for Claude Code or Codex and wants that agent in a Mac browser, next to the page they are reading. The verdict is the bill: Rill is free, and the AI charge stays with Anthropic or OpenAI. The homepage says there is no new subscription and no API keys.

It is a poor fit on Windows or Linux, and on an Intel Mac. The page says Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. It is also a poor fit if you do not have Claude Code or Codex and expected Rill to include a model. Browsing works without them. The AI features do not.
features: The FAQ "What does it cost?" on rill.love, checked 16 October 2026, says Rill is free and AI features run on your Claude Code or Codex plan. You sign in to one or both. Rill looks up projects from that history. There is no Rill price to compare with a $20 editor seat, because Rill does not sell one.

The agent work is the point of the product: ask about a page, send a task from any page, and keep a journal of what got done. New tasks are read-only until you allow edits, and in a git repository each edit can be undone. A web task is told to stop before a step that pays, places an order, sends, posts, or deletes, unless you told it to go through with that step.
History is files on the Mac. Passwords go in the Keychain. Tab sorting and day summaries can be turned off. Talking, which is hold Fn and speak, is in beta inside Settings.
limitations: Free does not mean the model is free. Claude Pro, which includes Claude Code, is $20 a month, or $17 a month with $200 billed up front. Codex comes with ChatGPT, and Plus is $20 a month. Those are the plans Rill runs on. If you do not already pay one of them, Rill's $0 is a browser.

It is beta, and the Mac requirement is narrow: Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. Prompt injection is called out on the page itself. Agents read pages as untrusted text. That lowers the risk and does not remove it.

The rating is Depends. Depends means the client is free and the usefulness sits on a Claude Code or Codex plan you already have. There is no affiliate relationship. The Visit button goes to rill.love.
